influences.name: Jack Bruce
influences.context: I grew up around my father, collaborated with him, and learned from him.

influences.name: Jimi Hendrix
influences.context: Hendrix had a positive effect on everybody, especially guitar players. He came to the sessions when we [Cream] did White Room in New York and was very encouraging about the song.

influences.name: George Harrison
influences.context: I met George during the session Cream did for Badge, and I was very impressed with his playing [under the pseudonym L'Angelo Mysterioso]... when you actually play with George you could see what an amazing guitar player he was, doing things that I hadn't even thought of.

influences.name: John McLaughlin
influences.context: When I first knew him he was a good guitar player, but I wouldn't put him any higher than that. Then I think he got into his meditation, Sri Chimnoy, and it seemed to really work for him. He became very turned on musically.
